searchText: Devnet-7 seems to be in a very bad state I started a new attack scenario at slot 182147 and (another attempt) at 182303. Participation dropped and hasn't recovered yet. Also, it seems some nodes forked off. well apparently every Prysm node is on its own fork https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-7.ethpandaops.io/forks but is that because of this tysm/thing? Some nimbus too, no? so not "prysm" exactly? well, Nimbus not all, no. two of them are but yeah, two of them are, will check what's going on tysm is a malicious prysm, afaik. but prysm has been offline / syncing the whole day from what I could tell there was also a slashing. Might it's what caused the chaos ``` INF 2026-08-08 19:51:05.442+00:00 execution payload invalid from EL client newPayload topics="gossip_blocks" executionPayloadStatus=INVALID executionPayload="(parent_hash: 099361a2, fee_recipient: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, state_root: 00000000, receipts_root: 00000000, prev_randao: c0571d85, block_number: 0, gas_limit: 300000000, gas_used: 0, timestamp: 1786218036, extra_data: hijack-2777, base_fee_per_gas: 0, block_hash: 525d1742, num_transactions: 95000, num_withdrawals: 1, blob_gas_used: 0, excess_blob_gas: 0, slot_number: 182303)" blck="(blck: (slot: 182303, proposer_index: 2711, parent_root: 683025f0, state_root: 1f4167b2, eth1data: (deposit_root: d70a2347, deposit_count: 0, block_hash: 37fcdcbf), graffiti: lodestar-nethermind-1 NMLS, proposer_slashings_len: 0, attester_slashings_len: 0, attestations_len: 2, deposits_len: 0, voluntary_exits_len: 0, sync_committee_participants: 410, block_number: 0, block_hash: , parent_hash: , fee_recipient: , bls_to_execution_changes_len: 0, blob_kzg_commitments_len: 0), signature: 8ab4931b)" ``` deliberate attack blocks I guess pretty weird-looking yeah that's mine all Nimbus is back on main/canonical branch was it just being stuck / offline because of the DoS? don't know checking Would be interesting to see how much of my lighthouse dos attack arrived at nimbus could be noise/misread by Dora too, seen that sometimes in terms of interpreting "forks" at least for `nimbus-reth-1`, yeah, it thought it had an EMPTY block at slot 182308 due to, yeah. apparently peers were not providing this envelope either via req/resp. it requested it ~1k times but it does look like the attack contributed thought, i.e. the envelope (i.e. the thing that was hindered by the attack, timingwise) was processed too slowly I'll summarize the attack tonorrow, already afk now. It took my own lighthouse node down. So, would be curious to see stats from lighthouse and prysm on this. I think there's a missing dedup check at lighthouse and prysm so, at least for Nimbus, it was ... semi-functioning per design. the fork choice behavior on perceived-EMPTY appears to have been correct the req/resp failing is more of a network question Ah that's interesting! we have some PRs in flight to address more structural recovery issues on this already Prysm has been offline for a few days now. I found the bug last night and opened a PR. I was waiting to get more eyes before pushing it to devnet7 branch but i think i may do it now. I think prysm was already offline before <@792404665068158998> 's attack
